title: Hash map, a post-office sorting desk
label: A turned-leg sorting desk with eight pigeonholes, buckets 0 to 7. Kiwi is in bucket 1, fig in 5, and raisin on plum in 3, a collision. A coding machine with a mod-8 dial rides a ruled rail; lime and orange wait in the tray.
caption: Each name is hashed and taken mod 8 to pick a pigeonhole; a collision overwrites nothing, the new letter is filed on top of the ones already there.
